content: dspy.inspect_history(n=1) prints the latest LM call to stdout: timestamp, the system and user messages DSPy actually sent, and the raw response text. It is a global LM history, not a pipeline trace. Official observability docs say it omits retrievers, tools, custom modules, latency, parameters, and relationships between steps, and that multiple calls in one prediction become a monolith log. Source: https://dspy.ai/tutorials/observability/ and https://dspy.ai/current/api/utils/inspect_history/
